user.title: Set up HomePod Sensors
user.description:
Your iOS Shortcut should POST sensor data to this webhook URL:

```
{webhook_url}
```

The integration creates a `switch.homepod_sensors_refresh` entity that pulses on the interval below. Expose it via HomeKit Bridge and run your Shortcut on the rising edge — see the README for full setup.

data_description.update_interval: How often the refresh switch pulses. Devices are marked stale after 3× this value.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HomePod Sensors instance is supported. It manages all HomePod Minis in your Apple Home.
